summary: HomeTrust Bancshares filed an 8-K announcing a definitive merger agreement to acquire Blue Ridge Bankshares. Under the deal, each Blue Ridge share converts into 0.086 HomeTrust shares, plus cash for fractional shares. Boards of both companies unanimously approved the transaction. Concurrently, Blue Ridge entered a warrant conversion agreement allowing cashless exercise of warrants before closing; remaining warrants will be assumed by HomeTrust if not converted by September 19, 2026. The merger proceeds via a two-step structure with bank-level combination thereafter. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder votes, with attention to warrant exercise timing impacting merger consideration.
